steps.en: Clone master and build it with its pinned numeric stack — Docker is the easy path
steps.zh: 克隆 master，连同锁死的数值计算栈一起构建，Docker 最省事

steps.en: Fetch the page's HTML yourself and pass it to one function
steps.zh: 自己下载网页 HTML，交给一个函数

steps.en: Splits the HTML into text blocks
steps.zh: 把 HTML 切成一个个文本块

steps.en: Computes features per block; a pre-trained scikit-learn model labels each content or not
steps.zh: 给每块算特征，由预训练的 scikit-learn 模型判定是不是正文

steps.en: Joins the blocks labelled content into one string and returns it
steps.zh: 把判为正文的块拼成一个字符串返回

value.en: The article body — with or without the comment thread — chosen by a model you can retrain on your own pages
value.zh: 拿到正文（可选带评论区），而做判断的模型可以拿你自己的网页重新训练

sources: https://github.com/dragnet-org/dragnet#getting-started (extract_content(r.content), extract_content_and_comments(r.content); load_pickled_model pre-trained models; sklearn-style fit/predict)

https://github.com/dragnet-org/dragnet#more-details-about-the-code-structure (Extractor = blockifier + feature extractors + model; blockify returns blocks; model predicts content/no-content per block)
